skills.skill: Count how many unit-fraction pieces (halves, thirds, fourths) are in a number of wholes

misconceptions.pattern: Gives the number of wholes rather than the number of unit-fraction pieces (e.g. 'how many halves in 3 wholes?' answered 3 instead of 6), not scaling by how many pieces each whole splits into.

strategies.intent: Split one whole into the unit-fraction pieces first (a whole makes 2 halves, 3 thirds, 4 fourths), then skip-count that many pieces for each whole.
